source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
3. Identify and summarize non-compliance issues: For each violation, write a detailed account of what was found during the inspection, referencing the specific regulation or standard that was not met. Include factual observations only, avoiding subjective commentary.

4. Create a timeline: Clearly document when the safety inspection took place and when the violations were noted. This timeline will provide context and may help in understanding how non-compliance occurred.

5. Compile evidence: Attach any available photographs, videos, written reports, and other evidence relevant to the violations. Ensure that they are properly labeled and easily referenced within your report.

6. Cite relevant regulations: For each non-compliance issue, quote the exact sections of the applicable health and safety regulations, industry standards, or corporate policies that were violated. This will demonstrate thoroughness and clarify the seriousness of the violations.

7. Document corrective actions: If corrective actions were discussed during the audit process or afterward, document these conversations and any decisions
